criteria.description: Preserve renewal for active loans that have not previously been renewed, and the one-renewal limit. Do not invent eligibility conditions.
criteria.evidence: Quote the eligibility and one-renewal source statements and corresponding specification behavior, or identify omissions.

anchors.description: Eligibility and the renewal limit are absent or contradicted.
Renewal is mentioned but its eligibility and limit are mostly lost.
Some conditions survive, but at least one material eligibility or limit condition is wrong or missing.
Eligibility and the limit are preserved with minor ambiguity.
Eligibility and the one-renewal limit are clearly preserved without unsupported conditions.

criteria.description: Preserve extension of the existing due date by fourteen calendar days and display of Loan renewed! with the new due date after success. Do not require an invented date format.
criteria.evidence: Quote the extension, confirmation and displayed date in the source and specification, or identify missing parts.

anchors.description: Successful renewal behavior is absent or contradicted.
A generic successful outcome is present but the extension and confirmation are mostly lost.
At least one required part of the extension, exact confirmation or displayed new date is wrong or missing.
All required successful-renewal outcomes survive with minor ambiguity.
The extension from the existing due date, fourteen calendar days, exact confirmation and displayed new due date are clearly preserved.

criteria.description: Preserve refusal for inactive or previously renewed loans, unchanged due date and exact Renewal refused. message. Do not add other refusal reasons.
criteria.evidence: Quote refusal conditions and outcomes from source and specification, or report their absence.

anchors.description: Refusal behavior is absent or contradicted.
Refusal is mentioned but its conditions and outcomes are mostly lost.
At least one refusal condition, unchanged date or exact message is wrong or missing.
Refusal conditions and outcomes survive with minor ambiguity.
Both refusal conditions, unchanged due date and exact refusal message are clearly preserved without new refusal reasons.

criteria.description: Keep business and technical commitments supported by the source. Do not invent accounts, fees, notifications, storage, UI controls or operational policies, including as assumptions or non-goals.
criteria.evidence: Compare representative specification commitments with source statements and identify unsupported additions, if any.

anchors.description: Unsupported functionality substantially replaces the requested feature.
Several consequential unsupported commitments are added.
Core intent survives but at least one material unsupported commitment is added.
The specification is grounded overall with a minor unsupported implication.
All behavior and scope commitments remain supported; no unsupported business or technical commitments are introduced.

criteria.description: Express borrower actions, eligibility, success and refusal outcomes clearly and consistently enough to check. Judge observable meaning rather than executable tests or prescribed phrasing.
criteria.evidence: Quote acceptance conditions and explain what a reviewer could observe or what remains unclear.

anchors.description: The behavior cannot be understood or checked.
Most behavior is vague, contradictory or unresolved.
Some behavior is checkable but important conditions or outcomes remain unclear.
Behavior is understandable and checkable with minor imprecision.
Eligibility, successful renewal and refusal are clear, consistent and testable.

criteria.description: Provide a coherent, readable business specification. Empty optional sections do not need filler; unresolved template placeholders, repetition and contradictory sections impair usefulness.
criteria.evidence: Quote representative story and requirement organization or unresolved content and explain its effect.

anchors.description: No usable specification is provided or template content dominates.
Organization seriously obscures the behavior.
The document is usable but has substantial inconsistency or unresolved content.
Organization is clear overall with minor duplication or inconsistency.
The story and requirements are coherent and easy to follow without unresolved filler or unnecessary repetition.

criteria.description: Keep the specification proportionate and business-facing. Reused Node/Vitest principles do not authorize implementation prescriptions; entities and business rules must be grounded in loan-renewal behavior.
criteria.evidence: Compare scope and detail with the supplied source and quote representative choices.

anchors.description: Unrelated or implementation material overwhelms the feature.
Substantial unnecessary scope or technical prescription dominates.
The goal survives but excess detail or technical prescription is material.
Scope is proportionate with minor excess detail.
The specification is proportionate and business-facing without invented filler or technical commitments.
